content.text: This is a request for access to a shared mailbox - a change to account access/permissions, which requires escalation rather than a KB-based fix.

input.reasoning_summary: Request to add requester to a shared mailbox is an access/permissions change with no urgency indicated, requiring Access Management to verify authorization before granting.

summary.reported: Requester Alex Example is asking to be added to the Sales team shared mailbox temporarily, to cover for a colleague (Sam) next month.
summary.checked: Confirmed this is a request for a new permission grant to a shared mailbox, not a technical fault; no KB article applies since this requires an actual access change.
summary.ruled_out: Not a technical/troubleshooting issue, so no KB fix applies.
summary.why_escalating: Granting or modifying mailbox access requires verification of the requester's identity and manager/owner approval before Access Management can add them to the shared mailbox, and set an appropriate end date for the temporary access.
